lead: An empty state: the placeholder shown when there is no data or no search results. Data-driven; every part is optional.

icon-size.title: Icon Size
icon-size.description: `iconSize` sets the size of the icons: a number is px, a string any CSS length (`"1.5rem"`). It applies to SVG icons; anything else sizes itself.
